answer: Sybil resistance binds each identity to bonded collateral and treats coordinated equivocation as a joint fault: if k identities sign conflicting histories, the penalty grows as O(k^2), rather than linearly. Detection also applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier to the controlling escrow, making larger swarms economically irrational. Independent honest nodes remain unaffected; a nadir in stake cannot be hidden by a mirror identity, while valid consensus earns nectar.
